zh-Hans: 在后面给他点压力，他应该就会乱了。
en: Put some pressure on him from behind, and he should crack.

zh-Hans: 趁现在得意吧，之后出什么事我可不管！
en: Enjoy it while you can. Don't blame me for what happens later!
Don't get cocky!

zh-Hans: 前面的路段，我会一口气咬上去！
en: I'll close right up in the next section!

zh-Hans: 我可没空在这种地方磨磨蹭蹭！
en: I haven't got time to mess around here!
I'll shake you off and get this over with!

zh-Hans: 可恶，为什么？难道是我更慢？！
en: Damn it! Why? Am I actually slower?!

zh-Hans: 这就快到终点了？早知道，开局就该拉大差距！
en: The finish already? I should've built a bigger lead at the start!
I can't catch him!

zh-Hans: 你要先跑？敢把我的忠告当耳旁风？
en: Taking the lead? You're ignoring my warning?

zh-Hans: 切，早知道就该再吓唬你一下！
en: Tch! I should've scared you a little more!
He's passing me here?!

zh-Hans: 不可能，难道他没踩刹车？！
en: Impossible! Did he even brake?!

zh-Hans: 终点还远着呢，再超回来不就行了！
en: The finish is still a ways off. I'll just pass him again!
Tch!
What?!
What?!
Tch!
He ignored my warning!
Tch! This is no fun!
Don't think you'll make it through in one piece!
Stay right there and behave!

zh-Hans: 就让我一路领先到终点吧！
en: I'll take the lead and hold it to the finish!

zh-Hans: 追上来了，是不是该提速了？
en: He's catching up. Time to pick up the pace?

zh-Hans: 前面的路段，我会一口气甩掉你！
en: I'll leave you behind in the next section!
Trying to pressure me from behind?

zh-Hans: 到了后半段的高速区，应该就能拉开！
en: I should pull away in the high-speed section near the end!
Tch! He won't drop back!
Persistent bastard! Get lost already!
I'll be taking the lead!

zh-Hans: 只要到了前面，就是我的天下！
en: Once I'm ahead, it's in the bag!

zh-Hans: 看来今晚的胜负，已经是我的了！
en: Looks like tonight's battle is mine!

zh-Hans: 你一犯错，我可不会放过！
en: Make a mistake, and I won't let it slide!

zh-Hans: 山路这么窄，你不可能再超回来！
en: On a pass this narrow, you're not getting back past me!

zh-Hans: 再快的人也会犯错，只要抓住那一下……
en: Even the fastest driver makes mistakes. All I have to do is exploit one...
Hmph.
Heh-heh.
Heh-heh-heh...
Heh-heh. Out of sight already.
I'll finish this right here!
Didn't even need to cheat.
This one's easy.

zh-Hans: 看来已经没机会被超回去了。
en: Looks like he's not getting back past me.

zh-Hans: 最好别把我们惹火了，之后出什么事我可不管！
en: You'd better not make us angry. Don't blame me for what happens later!
